name: statusline-suite
description: Unified statusline for Claude Code, Codex CLI and Cursor CLI: progress bars for context usage, git branch, model and session info.

interface.shortDescription: Context progress bar + git + model statusline for Claude/Codex/Cursor
interface.longDescription: Installs a unified statusline script across Claude Code and Cursor CLI (command-based statusLine) and configures the Codex CLI built-in TUI status line. Shows model, directory, git branch, context progress bar with color thresholds, and platform-specific segments (MCP/tools/todos on Claude; vim/worktree on Cursor).
defaultPrompt: 安装/更新三平台状态栏
校验三平台状态栏终态
